primitives.meaning: a target authoritatively held for a planned change; the specific prerequisite that is blocking it, named rather than described; a preparation window with time still in it
entryFilters: a target authoritatively held for a planned change
the specific prerequisite that is blocking it, named rather than described
a preparation window with time still in it
no instance of this journey is already open for the the target
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.asks: Can the holder clear this blocker themselves?

branches.label: Theirs to clear
branches.test: the prerequisite is something the holder controls - capacity to free, a version to move off, a dependency to accept, a confirmation to give

branches.label: Not theirs
branches.test: the prerequisite depends on a supplier, an internal approval, or a fixed period elapsing

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the person is active in the product and the action is taken there
the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Say that the change is held and why, with nothing asked of the holder - because there is nothing they can do.
primitives.brief: Say that the change is held and why, with nothing asked of the holder - because there is nothing they can do. A prompt to act where acting is impossible reads as blame and produces a support contact instead of a cleared blocker
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.state: held on a blocker the holder cannot clear
primitives.reEntry: if the blocker later becomes theirs to clear, the target qualifies again on the resolvable path

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the person is active in the product and the action is taken there
the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Name the one prerequisite, what clearing it involves, and the date after which the change can no longer be applied in this window.
primitives.brief: Name the one prerequisite, what clearing it involves, and the date after which the change can no longer be applied in this window. A generic notice that something is available leaves the holder to discover the blocker themselves, which is the whole reason the target is stuck
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: the specific named requirement that blocked progress is recorded as satisfied

primitives.reads: the the target re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.label: Blocker cleared
branches.test: the prerequisite is authoritatively satisfied on the target

branches.label: Change withdrawn
branches.test: the change was superseded or withdrawn before the prerequisite cleared

primitives.on: a named prerequisite cleared by the holder inside the preparation window
carries: what the holder was told, so readiness is not announced to them twice

primitives.state: change withdrawn before the blocker was cleared
primitives.reEntry: the next change with the same prerequisite scopes this target again

primitives.asks: Is a second prompt still worth sending?

branches.label: Time remains
branches.test: the preparation window has a period left in which clearing the blocker would still make the target ready

branches.label: Window closed
branches.test: no remaining action could make the target ready in this window

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the person is active in the product and the action is taken there
the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it

primitives.purpose: Send one further prompt naming the same prerequisite and the date it stops mattering.
primitives.brief: Send one further prompt naming the same prerequisite and the date it stops mattering. There is no third - a blocker nobody has cleared twice is a decision, not an oversight
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: the specific named requirement that blocked progress is recorded as satisfied

primitives.reads: the the target re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

primitives.state: preparation window closed with the blocker outstanding
primitives.reEntry: the target stays an unprepared member of the population and is prompted again by the next change that needs the same prerequisite
